The '''Motion Security Scanner''' was a [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion sensor]] produced by [[Zone Control]]. It could detect movement up to 100 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] away by measuring the differences in air displacement and temperature with low-powered pulses every half-second. Any being detected by the scanner would show up on a flat screen display. The scanner could detect movement through most walls, although [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] would often block the signal.
